title: Prepare a clear handoff when a concern exceeds self-help

sections.title: Understand the distinction
sections.body: A support handoff identifies the current need, urgency, location and usable route. Knowing a number is not evidence of service availability in another jurisdiction, and a future appointment does not cover an immediate emergency.

sections.title: Complete fictional practice material
sections.body: Use official US source cards linked in the lesson:911 is the emergency route for life-threatening emergencies;988 offers suicide or emotional-crisis support. They are not interchangeable with routine appointments or a universal safeguarding service. Fictional nonurgent clinic card for this paper exercise only: routine questions accepted weekdays 09–17 by text or phone; no out-of-hours response promised. No actual call or report is made.

sections.title: Work through the supplied case
sections.body: For a fictional person with a routine nonurgent appointment question at 18:00, record the closed clinic and a next-open inquiry. Explain how the choice changes if immediate life-threatening danger is actually present; do not wait to finish a worksheet in a real emergency.

sections.title: Try a different case before checking
sections.body: A person outside the US has an urgent concern and only a US card. May the plan assume 988 operates there, or rely on a routine clinic’s next-week appointment for immediate danger?

checks.title: Compare reasoning and review the supplied result
checks.body: The nonurgent question can await the ordinary route if circumstances remain nonurgent; do not invent an18:00 reply. Immediate life-threatening danger calls for the actual local emergency route. Partial: name a service without jurisdiction or usable mode. Incorrect: use a crisis line to test whether it works or treat every ordinary question as an emergency. Real safeguarding and clinical entry points require verified local scope.
criteria: Fictional rehearsal creates no actual contact evidence

checks.title: Check the changed case
checks.body: Neither assumption is supported. Use verified local emergency/crisis routes appropriate to the current urgency and accessible mode. In a real immediate emergency, seek local emergency assistance promptly; the hypothetical card supplies no foreign coverage.
criteria: Fictional rehearsal creates no actual contact evidence
